'''Yyintar''' was a [[Privateer/Legends|privateer]] and commentator on [[Gundark's Gear Datalog]] during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. Yyintar was a galley assistant served on the privateer [[Starship/Legends|vessel]] ''[[The Prishellan Dawn]]''.<ref name="GFT">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref>
